enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +33: Passive: +33 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Proficiency: Longsword: While equipped this item grants the wielder all required knowledge to wield a Longsword without proficiency penalties.
Nullification +156: Passive: +156 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Void Lore +23: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 23% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Insightful Spell Penetration +5: Passive: +5 Insight bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
